comment: Hosts allowed to appear as bare strings inside a kiosk bundle. Every entry needs a reason, and none of them may sit in a loadable position (src, href on <link>, CSS url(), fetch, import). The lint fails on anything not listed. See builds/kiosk/scripts/lint-external-urls.mjs.

hosts.reason: XML/SVG namespace identifiers. Never fetched — namespaces are compared as strings.
React embeds documentation links in its error messages. Only ever printed to the console.
Older React error-message links, same as above.
JSON Schema $schema identifiers emitted by zod. Compared as strings, never dereferenced.
End-screen CTA targets in the demo manifests. Opened in the visitor's browser when they click; never fetched by the bundle.
Capture provenance recorded in snapshot data-demo-source-url attributes. Not a loadable attribute.
Original hrefs preserved as data-demo-original-href when the capture parked anchor targets.
